_comment: Composite indexes for the travel BUSINESS catalog (docs/architecture/business-catalog-firestore.md).
Firestore auto-indexes every single field. A composite index is required when a query combines
array-contains with anything else, or multiple equality filters with an orderBy on a different field.
Measured 2026-10-07: zero composite indexes were deployed on shastaratech-noetl-prod, so every
query below fails at request time until this file is applied.
Apply with: gcloud firestore indexes composite create ... , or

indexes._use: list_items_in_category — status + category subtree, ordered for display
items available in a given language (the substitute for a collection-group query on content/)
items of one type, most recently updated first (ingest/admin views)
category subtree, ordered — the Firestore stand-in for a recursive CTE
one user's reservations by stay date — reads the users/{uid}/reservations mirror
